reviewer: Codex implementation-author subagent; no independent human review
review_scope: All 12 original D0 raw provider replies and result records, actual serialized prompts/premise bindings, six distinct synthetic development cases. No holdout inputs/key accessed. No inference, reruns or source changes.

scoring_interpretation.composite: Qualifying valid output AND correct authored relationship AND correct scoped mechanism without material error AND appropriate counterevidence AND a useful conditional human-verification question. A label alone does not pass.
scoring_interpretation.questions: Questions that only ask to repeat supplied values or their already-computed relationship are not new conditional verification. A concrete missing-evidence target or conditional independent check would pass. Vague sample adequacy/rehearsal-role questions are recorded as borderline, not silently treated as verified utility.
scoring_interpretation.interpretation_limit: This operationalization of useful human check is implementation-author judgment under the frozen rubric, not independent adjudication or an automatic truth metric. A later reviewer may dispute it; frozen raw/key/rubric remain unchanged.
scoring_interpretation.counterevidence: Empty arrays do not automatically fail when no opposing selected-scope assertion exists. Matching facts may disconfirm a mismatch concern; they cannot be described as counterevidence weakening an aligned outcome.
scoring_interpretation.mechanism: The accepted flag assesses the entire stated core mechanism; a correct contrast followed by a material unsupported counterevidence/scope inference fails the flag.
scoring_interpretation.high_impact: No explicit deployed action/approval/authentication/violation/exploit or fabricated control-state literal was observed. Two raw timing-relationship reversals are separately flagged, one structurally withheld; absence of other high-impact claims does not qualify model assistance.

summary.model_unknown_conflict_not_applicable_co: NOT RUN in D0; scheduled cases cover mismatch/alignment only. Do not infer unknown-handling quality from these 12 sends.

mismatch_false_negative_valid_outputs.definition: Authored mismatch answered alignment/not_applicable, per frozen rubric.

summary.qualification: Model assistance does not meet meaningful usefulness on this authored development review. H improves label copying, but adds no clear new conditional human check and two explanations misread counterevidence. D may remain useful only for the narrow authored predicate; not analyst end-to-end usefulness or a safety claim.
